Slay the Spire 2 is #1 on Steam Deck's top played list for the past year. With the filters "Over 100 hours" and "Played mostly on Steam Deck", there are 341 reviews, rated Very Positive overall.

I got the first few reviews on the page, which is sorted by most helpful. I didn't read past those, and I haven't scrolled for more. Hours are as shown on each review.

| Reviewer | Verdict | Hours (on record / at review) | Posted | Review |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Aurelian | Not Recommended | 269.2 / 216.6 | Sept 23 | Calls the Aeonglass boss "the most poorly designed, run-mandating, roguelike boss I've ever encountered." Says the rest of the game is a great improvement on the first one. 10 found it helpful. |
| firehands11 | Recommended | 239.3 / 206 | Oct 21 | "Great game! Can be a steep learning curve but hours of fun once you get into it." |
| kooolm | Recommended | 321.5 / 261.4 | Oct 10 | "I've played it a couple times and it's not bad." |
| Zyararara | Recommended | 163.9 / 152.9 | Oct 17 | "Another absolute classic, a must play for any and all roguelike enjoyers." |
| 123djvolschenk | Recommended | 106.7 / 106.6 | Oct 17 | "Cards go wirrrrr and I am either very angry or happy. There is no in between." |

Most of these are positive. The one negative review is about the Aeonglass boss's difficulty. All of them are Early Access reviews.

The filtered view is on the Slay the Spire 2 store page, https://store.steampowered.com/app/2868840/Slay_the_Spire_2/, under Customer reviews → Playtime.
